records.name: Illusionist Drehblick
records.biography_en: Can keep both interpretations moving until either one feels certain. His HyperNorm spinner makes one interpretation chase the other around a circle. A dissonant card asks what remains when his hand stops turning. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gewissheit wird durch fortgesetzte Bewegung aufrechterhalten.

variant_notes.note_en: Can keep both interpretations moving until either one feels certain.

records.name: Denkerin Andersoben
records.biography_en: Has turned the idea over and is still deciding which part moved. Her inverted HyperNorm picture keeps the same mountains under a newly inconvenient sky. A dissonant card asks whether the frame or the assumption moved. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Gedanke wurde gewendet. Die Lage wird neu geprüft.

variant_notes.note_en: Has turned the idea over and is still deciding which part moved.

records.name: Blätterer Bewegtnoch
records.biography_en: Knows the movement depends on several patient things staying still. His HyperNorm flipbook grants movement to carefully arranged stillness. A dissonant card lingers between pages and notices the work nobody applauds. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bewegung beruht auf mehreren geduldig unbewegten Zuständen.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the movement depends on several patient things staying still.

records.name: Sphinx Fastgelöst
records.biography_en: Would appreciate an answer that explains why the question was locked. His HyperNorm box seals a riddle that came with no agreed reason for asking it. A dissonant card wonders whether opening it is the same as answering. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Antwort benötigt vorab Auskunft über den Verschluss.

variant_notes.note_en: Would appreciate an answer that explains why the question was locked.

records.name: Gedankenspinne Fadenfolge
records.biography_en: Can connect every point and would like somebody to notice the knot. Her HyperNorm threads connect every approved idea to the approved centre. A dissonant card notices the knot making the map seem inevitable. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung ist hergestellt. Der Knoten widerspricht noch.

variant_notes.note_en: Can connect every point and would like somebody to notice the knot.

records.name: Aha-Wart Leuchtjetzt
records.biography_en: Experiences a revelation every time the same switch finally works. His HyperNorm bulb announces the arrival of an insight management already recognizes. A dissonant card asks what he learned while the switch refused to work. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Erleuchtung bestätigt zunächst den nun funktionierenden Schalter.

variant_notes.note_en: Experiences a revelation every time the same switch finally works.
